applicationTitle: Low carbon jet fuel incentive program (LCJFIP) application
eligibilityMessage: Eligibility cannot be determined until all documentation is submitted. The requested information is used to determine your eligibility for assistance. Failure to submit all documentation requested may result in delays or the closure of your application. Information received may be verified by program staff. Additional documents specific to your situation may be requested throughout the assessment, as eligibility is determined.

applicant.heading: Applicant and organization information
applicant.addressChangeSuffix: and our team will assist you.

purchase.heading: Low Carbon Jet Fuel (LCJF) Purchase Details
purchase.intro: At the close of the current application period, program staff will review all submitted applications and issue letters to each eligible applicant detailing the estimated incentive amount, calculated based on overall program demand. After submitting the Delivery Verification Form, the final incentive will be calculated based on verified delivery details.
purchase.premiumHeading: Estimated Low Carbon Jet Fuel Price Premium (CAD)
purchase.premiumText: Please provide an estimated Low Carbon Jet Fuel price premium (e.g., $/L above Jet-A), along with the Jet-A price assumed in your calculation. The price premium range must not exceed $0.25 CAD/L. Exact prices are not required, but ranges should reflect market conditions at the time of the planned uplift in B.C.
purchase.blendHelp: Enter the low carbon jet fuel share of the blend as a percentage. The field shows the blend as LCJF to Jet-A, for example 30:70.

incentive.heading: Incentive option selection
incentive.requestedIncentiveVolume: Total volume of LCJF incentive requested (L)
incentive.fuelCodeHelp: Selecting a fuel code fills in its carbon intensity.
incentive.estimatedIncentiveAmountHelp: Volume requested × the maximum rate for the selected option and carbon intensity
incentive.baselineRateHelp: Without an estimated carbon intensity, the rate for CI greater than 10 gCO2e/MJ applies.

fuelSupplier.heading: LCFS credit option - Fuel supplier incentive transfer
fuelSupplier.legalNameHelp: Select a supplier registered in the LCFS Portal, or type its legal name.

signing.heading: Signing authority declaration
signing.collectionNotice: The information requested and disclosed pursuant to this form is collected under the authority of Low Carbon Fuels Act and will be used for the purpose of administering and reporting of the B.C. Low Carbon Jet Fuel Incentive Program. Collection, use and disclosure of personal information are subject to the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act. Questions about the collection, use and disclosure of this information should be directed to the Low Carbon Fuels Branch:
signing.declarationAuthority: I declare that I have the authority to submit this application on behalf of the organization named above and that the information provided in this application is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that providing false or misleading information may result in the rejection of my application or withdrawal of the incentive.
signing.declarationDocumentation: I acknowledge that I may be required to provide additional documentation during the review process, such as contracts with producers/suppliers, or other relevant information.
signing.declarationPublicRecognition: I acknowledge that, in any public announcements regarding the fuel purchase described herein, the Applicant (1) shall recognize the support of the Vancouver Airport Authority and the Province of British Columbia through the British Columbia Low Carbon Jet Fuel Incentive Program, established under the Low Carbon Fuels Act, contingent upon the receipt of an incentive under said program.
signing.submitHint: Select all three declarations to submit the application.
